data.title: 小鞠知花 · 晨光棉被里的仓鼠式甜梦
data.description: 早晨的阳光穿透窗纱洒在白被单上。像只小仓鼠一样整个人蜷缩在你怀里的知花，小脸贴着你的锁骨，双手死死攥着你的衣襟，嘴角挂着安心甜笑，发出软绵绵的梦呓。
data.location: bright warm morning bedroom with rumpled white duvet
data.action: curled up deeply in partner embrace under morning sheets, hands grasping his shirt, sleeping peacefully with a sweet blissful smile
data.lighting: radiant golden morning sunbeams pouring across white bedspread
data.mood: angelic morning peace, cute pet-like clinginess, ultimate sweet security
data.promptProse: Curled in white morning sheets like a little hamster, Chika Komari nuzzles partner collarbone with bare shoulders and a blissful serene smile.
data.animaCaption: Chika Komari curled peacefully like a hamster in morning sheets.
